mandate: C319 — test the cross-sectional COINTEGRATION / PAIRS mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (3456 pre-registered configs). For each unordered pair (a,b): rolling hedge ratio beta = cov_L(logPa,logPb)/var_L(logPa); spread = logPb - beta*logPa; rolling z = (spread - mean_L)/std_L; mean-reversion position = -sign(z)*clip((|z|-exit)/(entry-exit),0,1); beta-hedged dollar-neutral weights; portfolio = mean over active pairs; costs charged on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and cointegration-vs-momentum-vs-beta_carry-vs-placebo attribution.

methodology.signals: beta=cov_L(logPa,logPb)/var_L(logPa); spread=logPb-beta*logPa; z=(spread-mean_L)/std_L; pos=-sign(z[t-1])*clip((|z[t-1]|-exit)/(entry-exit),0,1); pair_pnl=pos*spr_ret/(1+|beta[t-1]|); spr_ret=r_b-beta[t-1]*r_a; causal shift(1).
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp, beta-hedged dollar-neutral per pair; portfolio = mean over active pairs.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute; a lookback without enough data yields NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 3456 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference (cointegration) vs momentum (opposite sign) vs beta_carry (always-long spread) vs placebo (per-pair time-permuted spr_ret); shares = |net|/sum.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
